# bevy_tak

A [Bevy](https://bevyengine.org) plugin family for emitting
[Cursor-on-Target](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cursor_on_Target) (CoT) events
— the messaging format used by ATAK / WinTAK situational-awareness clients.

> **Status:** pre-1.0. Today the family ships a logging sink only;
> network transports (UDP multicast Mesh SA, TAK Server TCP/TLS) are
> tracked for a future release.

## Demo — `a5_drone_swarm`

The flagship example is a top-down 100 km × 100 km area centred on
London with:

- three patrolling drones rendered against an
  [A5 cell-grid](https://github.com/jonititan/bevy_a5) overlay,
- static ground targets that light up only while inside a drone's
  detection radius and fade out 30 s after last contact,
- a live left-side console showing the most recent CoT events as they
  emit, plus a keyboard command line
  (`goto <drone_index> <lat> <lon>` / `clear` / `help`),
- a full CoT event stream — friendly self-SA per drone, hostile-atom
  events for detected targets — written to a newline-delimited XML log
  under `std::env::temp_dir()`.

```sh
cargo run -p bevy_tak --example a5_drone_swarm
```

It exercises the whole data path the crate family is designed for:
gameplay systems producing `OutboundCot` messages, the `TakLogPlugin`
draining them under `TakSet::Send`, and a replayable on-disk log
compatible with standard TAK tooling.

## Crates

| Crate | Role |
|---|---|
| [`bevy_tak`](crates/bevy_tak) | Facade. Re-exports the core types and bundles a `TakPlugins` PluginGroup. |
| [`bevy_tak_core`](crates/bevy_tak_core) | Transport-agnostic ECS surface: components, messages, system sets. Re-exports [`cot-proto`](https://crates.io/crates/cot-proto). |
| [`bevy_tak_log`](crates/bevy_tak_log) | Newline-delimited CoT XML logger. **Bevy-free by default** — usable from non-Bevy simulations. |

## Install

```toml
[dependencies]
bevy = "0.18"
bevy_tak = "0.1"
```

## Quick start

```rust
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy_tak::{log::CotLoggerResource, TakPlugins};

fn main() {
    App::new()
        .add_plugins(DefaultPlugins)
        .add_plugins(TakPlugins)
        .insert_resource(
            CotLoggerResource::file("events.cot.log").expect("open log file"),
        )
        .run();
}
```

Producer systems write `OutboundCot` messages before `TakSet::Encode`;
the logger drains them in `PostUpdate` under `TakSet::Send`.

## Examples

- [`a5_drone_swarm`](crates/bevy_tak/examples/a5_drone_swarm.rs) — the
  flagship demo described above.
- [`log_only`](crates/bevy_tak/examples/log_only.rs) — minimal headless
  example that emits one CoT event per second to a temp-file log. No
  windowing; mirrors the data path a non-Bevy simulation would use.

```sh
cargo run -p bevy_tak --example a5_drone_swarm
cargo run -p bevy_tak --example log_only
```

## Design notes

The split exists so that **non-Bevy callers can depend on `bevy_tak_log`
directly** without pulling in the Bevy engine — specifically, agent-based
simulations (e.g. [krABMaga](https://github.com/krABMaga/krABMaga)) that
want CoT as a wire/log format for interop with TAK clients.

System-set ordering is `Receive → Decode → Dispatch` in `PreUpdate` and
`Encode → Send` in `PostUpdate`. User systems producing outbound CoT
should run `.before(TakSet::Encode)`.

## Bevy compatibility

| `bevy_tak` | `bevy` |
|---|---|
| 0.1 | 0.18 |
